name: Cancel an upgrade halfway, then roll it back
covers: The arrow saying the package is newer, a secret setting, the files an upgrade adds and deletes, a yes/no question, Cancel during a deploy, and Roll back

steps.say: Type the payments API key, a secret setting new in 1.1

hover.text: The package (1.1.0) is newer: deploying here updates it.

steps.say: The green arrow beside blue's version points up: the open package is newer than what is installed
blue is on 1.0.0, so the button says Update.
1.1.0 no longer has password-reset.html, so it will be deleted (crossed out, in red)

steps.expect: Run a settings check on the old version first?
steps.say: Say No to the optional check of the old version's settings
Now cancel, while the settings are being checked. The service is already stopped and a backup taken, so NetDeploy offers to put things back.
Yes, restore the backup and start the service again

steps.checkpoint: blue is back as it was
look: The folder list still shows blue on v1.0.0.
The Log tab shows the cancel, then the backup put back and the service started.
The blue.backups folder, next to blue, holds the backup.
